over: infer a switch-off from any boolean option at the call, which would guess at every adopter's helpers
credit a chokepoint by the call alone, as before: on umami seven routes calling parseRequest with skipAuth: true were credited with authentication that never runs
because: the discriminating test from umami's conjecture c-3b2e2d8f (coordinator's c-238dda5b): with the PR build, POST api/auth/login (skipAuth: true) and a probe entrance on GET api/boards/[boardId] (check on) were both traced as structural chokepoint wrapping its handler: authenticate through parseRequest, so the reading could not tell them apart. Only a literal true counts, so an option passed as a variable keeps the credit: the text must prove the check is off
